frames.notes: next time 直接作连词引时间从句

frames.frame: whether that be [A] / be it [A], [B] or [C]
frames.notes: 省略should的让步虚拟，be前移倒装

examples.text: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or lucrative career.

frames.gloss: 设想某情景，再展开推演

examples.text: Imagine that you favor increasing the minimum wage in our state, and I do not.

examples.text: Across the country, factory owners are now grappling with a new challenge: instead of having too many workers, they may end up with too few.

examples.text: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.

frames.gloss: 报道动词作插入语，分隔前后成分

frames.related: rather than + V-ing + 祈使句（与其A不如B）

examples.text: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes—all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
